svg.text: Sheet 2. Printed parts, bolt and gauge card (left-hand parts; mirror for the right-hand latch)
Millimetres, nominal sizes. Print in PETG or nylon, 0.2 layers, 4 walls, 40 % infill or more. Sliding fits have 0.1 to 0.3 clearance; ease with a file if a printer runs tight.
Plate 45 x 65 x 3. Slot 14 x 28.6 through (u 19.6 to 33.6,
v 30.7 to 59.3). Positions below are (u, v) from the corner.
3 mounting holes dia 3.2 through, counterbored dia 6.2 x 1.8 deep
2 lug-screw holes dia 3.2 through, counterbored dia 6.2 x 1.8 deep
from the BACK, at (36.5, 37) and (36.5, 53); these two counterbores
break 0.2 into the slot's inner end, as intended.
Post behind the plate (dashed): 2.5 x 11 x 10 deep, u 42.5 to 45,
v 49 to 60. Square peg 3.4 x 3.4 x 3 long on its outer face, centred
v 54.5 and 5.55 behind the plate's back: it locates the spring.
Print with the front face on the bed (post up); support under
the peg only (a 3 mm overhang). Clean the holes with a 3.2 drill.
2 Slide, end view from the screen's middle
2 Slide, from above (room at the bottom)
One piece. The neck (2.4 x 28 x 3.5) passes through the plate's slot; the tab goes in from the back of the plate.
A: bolt bore dia 5.7, through, 14 above the bottom face.
B: spring bore dia 6.6, open toward the screen's middle, 8.1 deep (its bottom 0.5 beyond the tab's inner face).
C: pilot 2.4 square, from the bottom face up into the bolt bore, 5.5 from the carriage's outer face, for the retention screw (part 7).
Print with the bottom face (v 31) on the bed; no support.
in the base, on its centre line
Nose: 2 long, ground down to about dia 3. Flat: 0.8 deep, 6 long, 2.5 from the inner end.
Cut and grind with an abrasive wheel (the wire is hardened).
The flat faces down (toward the screen's bottom edge) when fitted.
